title: FOUNDER HEAVEN
subtitle: SILHOUETTE ELEVATION

text: TOP PLATEAU ~900 m ACROSS: terraced gardens
step up from the rim; low cream buildings,
orchards, pools; a few slender brass wind-spires
UNDERSIDE: a gentle TEARDROP of pale rock
tapering downward, trailing thin skirts of mist;
NOTHING holds it up: no chains, no pillars,

laws: THE SILHOUETTE IS THE IDENTITY: teardrop rock below, one green terraced plateau above, a few slender brass spires. Every appearance keeps this outline.
IT FLOATS FREE IN OPEN SKY. Nothing visible holds it up, ever.
FROM THE JUNGLE FLOOR IT READS SMALL AND HIGH; individual doors and people are never readable from below.
GRACEFUL PROTOPIA: pale stone, cream, green, brass. Never chrome, never neon, never engines.
